title: This 345-million-year-old fossil had scientists fooled for decades
caption:
For thirty years, Westlothiana lizziae was celebrated as one of the first reptiles to conquer dry land. High-energy X-ray scans just peered inside the rock and found fish teeth and internal gills—revealing that key adaptations for land actually started in the water.

Source: Sciencedaily - This 345-million-year-old fossil had scientists fooled for decades
